research_rationale: Full frozen-corpus recheck: Section 6(b) ends the Commission at the earlier of 30 days after actual submission and August 30, 2003. No actual submission/receipt evidence appears. July 31 is a report deadline; August 30 is an outside bound rather than a proved earliest end. All original text is identical to the earlier packet. Reread/reconciled all complete actor contexts, every own-term lead including alternate formatting, earlier chain, missing/conflicts and machine search scopes. No newly supplied actor or own-term variant establishes the missing submission event. The original/alternate term wording agrees.  EO:13316 section 3 revokes this full named order effective September 30, 2003 under section 6; the later formal revocation does not prove the earlier trigger. Generic reference exclusion counts changed without supplying an additional located terminating actor. No provisional status or current predicate is altered. No deadline is accepted as an end.

review_notes.search_assessment: Read all three search scopes and hit counts. The OFR catalog covers 6,938 post-1937 records and 7,619 saved EO texts; all assigned orders fall within that period. The eCFR/CFR search is point-in-time through 2026-10-14 across 49 titles. The USC search covers 58 title files only through 2026-10-09 and expressly omits the final five days of the legal cutoff. These searches are useful bounded EO/regulatory leads, but contain no report-submission evidence and do not search non-EO presidential extension instruments. Counts are not source text. No search IDs are selected while material closure remains unsupported.
